decisions.statement: Which files import a path that moves is read from beside that path's page.
An index naming no importer of a path that moves leaves that path none.
A file moving in the same act is no importer of the paths that move.
A body spelling the last part of a path that moves beside a separator names that path.
A body spelling that last part with no path separator beside it names no path.
The bodies searched are the ones the caller hands in, as paths with a reader.
A path the caller already knows about is left out of that search.
A body git does not keep is left out of that search.
Which bodies those are is read off the name git reads, rather than parsed.
A body git does not keep is rewritten between one reading of it and the next.
A body is searched whatever language that body is written in.

definition: the tracked files that name a path
